title: Louisiana Forek Coat of Arms
description: A heraldic coat of arms featuring a blue shield with three golden pinecones, mounted on a wooden background. The crest includes a silver knight's helmet, surrounded by abundant pink and yellow foliage with flowers, set against a dark Louisiana swamp landscape with cypress trees and water.
prompt: Heraldic coat of arms on a wooden shield with a blue field containing three golden pinecones, topped with a silver knight helmet, surrounded by lush pink and yellow oak leaves and flowers, a golden banner reading 'FOREK' above and 'LOUISIANA' below, set in a dark nighttime Louisiana bayou background with cypress trees draped in Spanish moss and water lilies, rich illustrative style.
